reuse.why: Introduces a shouldSkipBulkBudget predicate and reuses getBudgetData for copy-previous-month, but the three average actions do not use the predicate and keep their own SQL filters.

duplication.why: The skip rule now exists as the TS predicate (copyPreviousMonth, setZero) and as three identical extended WHERE clauses (set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg, set12MonthAvg); setZero adds a fourth category query with the same joins, and the income/tracking check stays copied per action.

placement.why: Everything stays in budget/actions.ts where the bulk actions live; the predicate is a reasonable local helper.

scope.why: Focused on the request, with some incidental reformatting of the getBudgetData Pick type into overlong lines.

maintainability.why: A future change to which categories month-wide actions write must be made in a TS predicate and three SQL strings, which already disagree in form (goal_def != null vs IS NULL in SQL).

bypasses_abstraction.where: set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg and set12MonthAvg bypass the new shouldSkipBulkBudget predicate and encode hidden/group-hidden/template exclusion in their own SQL WHERE clauses.

disguised_duplication.where: The same exclusion rule is expressed once as a TS predicate and three times as `c.hidden = 0 AND g.hidden = 0 AND c.goal_def IS NULL` SQL in the average actions, i.e. reshaped rather than shared.

one_place.where: Rule split between shouldSkipBulkBudget (copyPreviousMonth, setZero) and the WHERE clauses of set3MonthAvg/set6MonthAvg/set12MonthAvg in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts.
